name: Truist Mortgage (Truist Bank)
notes: Researched from public truist.com mortgage pages only. Sign in (truist.com): User ID + Password, "Sign in", "Forgot user ID?", "Reset password". Enroll: Set up personal banking > Account number, 10-digit mortgage account number + last 4 SSN (transferred loans: ZIP + email used with prior servicer). Manage & Pay: online via Make payment > Select frequency for one-time, recurring or Bi-Weekly; recurring drafts from checking/savings on any day from the 1st to the 16th for payments due on the 1st (day choice not modelled); Recurring Payments Draft Authorization Form alternative; phone 800-634-7928 (M-F 8-8, Sat 9-3 ET); mail P.O. Box 79041 Baltimore; branch. Truist advises against bank bill pay. Late charge if not received within the grace period (length not stated). Statements under Documents; paperless opt-in after sign-in; 1098 by January 31. Assistance 800-443-1032. The Truist Bank deposit dossier (banks category) is a different catalog record; this one is the mortgage servicing site. autopay.note: Recurring payments draft your checking or savings account on the day you choose, from the 1st to the 16th for payments due on the 1st.

help.title: Ways to pay your mortgage
paragraphs: Sign in, select your mortgage, choose Make payment and then Select frequency to make a one-time payment, set up recurring payments or join the Bi-Weekly payment plan.

You can also call 800-634-7928 (Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET), pay at any Truist branch, or mail a check with your statement coupon to Truist Bank, P.O. Box 79041, Baltimore, MD 21279-0041.
We recommend not paying through your bank's bill pay service: we cannot track those payments until they arrive, which can cause delays, late charges or misapplied extra payments.

help.title: Recurring payments
paragraphs: Recurring payments are drawn from your checking or savings account on any day you choose from the 1st through the 16th of the month (for payments due on the 1st). Set them up online under Make payment and Select frequency, or with the Recurring Payments Draft Authorization Form. You can update your preferences at any time.

help.title: Statements and paperless
paragraphs: Sign in and open Documents, then Accounts and your mortgage, to view statements. Opt in to paperless statements after signing in. Your IRS Form 1098 is ready in online banking by January 31.

help.title: Enroll in online banking
paragraphs: Choose Set up personal banking, then Account number, and enter your 10-digit Truist mortgage account number and the last four digits of your Social Security number. If your loan was transferred to Truist, also use the ZIP code and email address you used with your previous servicer, and wait about a week after the transfer date.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: Options may include refinancing, a repayment plan, a loan modification, a forbearance extension, or a short sale or deed in lieu if you cannot stay in the home; availability depends on your investor.
Call 800-443-1032 (Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 10 p.m., Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. ET) or schedule a callback from a Home Preservation specialist.

extra.intent: Using the Truist mortgage help pages, find the latest day of the month a recurring payment can be drafted for a payment due on the 1st. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Any day from the 1st through the 16th.
